sections.html:
Features and benefits

1. 50 µm PAINT COATING POWDER COVERS

  • significant additional corrosion protection that allows the connectors to be used in a C3 corrosive atmosphere
  • it perfectly matches the color of the profiled plate cover
  • It has UV stabilizers that ensure color stability
  • modern powder coating technology Powder.coat ensures the durability of the coating during installation and a long service life.

2. METAL SUBSTANCE

  • the special shape of the steel washer ensures the correct placement of the EPDM sealant.

3. THE EVENT

  • The ETANCO brand is a European manufacturer of fasteners and fastening systems for the construction industry.
  • The characteristic marking of ETANCO products enables them to be easily recognized
  • strict production control carried out by the internal laboratory guarantees high quality products
  • each production lot is given a unique number that enables its precise identification
  • all our products have current reference documents developed in cooperation with renowned research institutes

4. EPDM SEAL

  • from the best sealing material - EPDM
  • it does not lose its elasticity over time, the aging period is very long
  • resistant to climate change and UV radiation
  • After installation, it is vulcanized to the plate, creating a tight bond
  • it retains its properties even under the influence of temperatures between -50°C and +100°C

5. ZINC HARD COATING

  • basic, most important corrosion protection, 12 µm zinc layer thickness, quality guarantee, our own modern zinc installation ensures the highest quality of the corrosion protection layer

6. DRILLING THE SELF-GUARANTEE TIP POINT

  • The self-drilling drill bit specially developed by ETANCO
  • optimal drilling of the plate in a short time
  • the protective layer of the zinc layer does not come off when drilling through the plate
  • Drilling power DC max 2 x 1.0 mm
